business_summary: Nagase Brothers Inc. provides educational services in Japan. The company operates cram and preparatory schools for students preparing for entrance exams, as well as swimming lessons and fitness clubs. It also provides educational programs for elementary, junior high, and high school students; educational services for university students and working adults; tutoring and individualized instruction services for elementary, middle, and high school students; digital education content, such as IT passport preparation courses for large corporations; language and DX human resource development training; and online lessons and tests. In addition, the company engages in educational book publishing; online school; English language schools for children; and international business activities. Nagase Brothers Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.
